Houston West is CyrusOne's only 'West' campus in Houston in these filings (the other Houston property is Galleria), and Houston West 3 is the 320,000+ sq ft shell shown under development from FY2013. verification: Pages support 2016, not the researcher's 2015. Cited Business Wire URL returned HTTP 403 (not worked around); in any case an open-house notice is not an operating statement. CyrusOne 10-Ks on SEC EDGAR bracket the start: FY2014 10-K lists Houston West 3 only in the development table (329,000 NRSF under development); FY2015 10-K (as of 2015-12-31) shows Houston West 3 with no colocation space (only 8,564 sq ft of leased office and 5,304 sq ft supporting space, 13,868 total) and still in the development table with estimated completion "1Q'16"; FY2016 10-K (as of 2016-12-31) lists "Houston - Houston West III (DH #1)" as a pre-stabilized property with 52,932 colocation sq ft, 6 MW critical load, 5% leased. So the first data hall entered service between 2015-12-31 and 2016-12-31. Two caveats for the orchestrator: (1) the building had leased office space and an open house in December 2015, so 2015 is the year the shell opened, 2016 the year the first data hall was in service; (2) if the 'site' is treated as the whole Houston West campus rather than the expansion building, the first building (Houston West 1) was operating well before 2012 (97% leased at 2013-12-31) and this year would not apply. The address-to-building tie is unverified as noted in site_match; downgrade to not_verified if an address-level match is required.
